agent_comments:
Rich already supports orange. Use a named colour in a style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")`, or in markup, `[orange1]Hello[/]`. You can also use an RGB value such as `#ffaf00`. The full list of named colours is in the colour appendix: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst

If none of these gives you what you need, please ask in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions first. Feature requests are approved there before an issue is opened.
